site.title: Research Artifacts MetaGraph
site.subtitle: Coding Scheme Explorer
site.description: Interactive explorer for research artifacts coded from Business Process Management (BPM) conference papers.

labels.stepsHint: Click a type to filter papers
labels.landscapeDescription: Papers by publication year and track. Hover for details, click to open.
labels.graphDescription: Explore connections between papers based on shared keywords and types of artifact.

typesOfInquiry.label: Formal Science
typesOfInquiry.description: Formal/mathematical inquiry: proofs, formalisms, and analytical models.

typesOfInquiry.label: Information Systems Engineering
typesOfInquiry.description: Design-science and engineering contributions such as frameworks, tools, and prototypes.

typesOfInquiry.label: Scientific Study
typesOfInquiry.description: Empirical studies that test hypotheses or theories.

typesOfInquiry.label: Inductive Study
typesOfInquiry.description: Exploratory, theory-building research grounded in observation.

typesOfInquiry.label: Meta-analysis
typesOfInquiry.description: Literature reviews and syntheses of existing research.

typesOfInquiry.label: Case Study Application
typesOfInquiry.description: Applied work reporting on real-world industrial deployments.

typesOfArtifact.label: Technique
typesOfArtifact.description: A specific procedure applied within a broader method.

typesOfArtifact.label: Method
typesOfArtifact.description: A structured, repeatable way of achieving a research or engineering goal.

typesOfArtifact.label: Prototype
typesOfArtifact.description: An early-stage implementation used to demonstrate feasibility.

typesOfArtifact.label: Framework
typesOfArtifact.description: A structuring set of concepts, practices, or components.

typesOfArtifact.label: Model
typesOfArtifact.description: An abstract representation of a system, process, or phenomenon.

typesOfArtifact.label: Language
typesOfArtifact.description: A notation, modeling language, or formal language.

typesOfArtifact.label: Design Concept
typesOfArtifact.description: An idea or principle intended to guide design.

typesOfArtifact.label: Report
typesOfArtifact.description: A descriptive account of findings, an application, or a case.

typesOfArtifact.label: Taxonomy
typesOfArtifact.description: A classification scheme organizing concepts or artifacts.

about.title: About This Project
about.introduction: This explorer presents research artifacts coded directly from the research_artifacts.schema.json research-artifact schema, using the same field names and structure defined there. Including every artifact a paper contributes, its research and evaluation methods, empirical evidence, and threats to validity. The underlying data comes from Business Process Management (BPM) conference proceedings.

sections.title: Types of Artifact
sections.content: Papers are classified by the type(s) of artifact they contribute: Algorithms, prototypes, frameworks, and so on. A paper may contribute more than one type.

sections.title: Data Source
sections.content: Data is the result of manually analyzing BPM conference proceedings covering research components, contributed artifacts, research and evaluation methods, empirical evidence, and threats to validity.
